MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64)
      - CASE
          WHEN CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) < 10
            OR (CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) <= 14)
          THEN 0
          ELSE 1
        END
  END AS age
WHERE (age IS NOT NULL AND age <= 78)
   OR p.current_team = 'Capitanes de Arecibo'
   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0
   OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL OR p.birth_date = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^([0-9]{4})', 1) AS INT64) -
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]{1,2})', 1) AS INT64) > 10
          OR (
            CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]{1,2})', 1) AS INT64) = 10
            AND CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/([0-9]{1,2})', 1) AS INT64) > 14
          )
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
  END AS age
WHERE (age IS NOT NULL AND age <= 78)

   OR (p.mvp_awards IS NOT NULL AND p.mvp_awards <> '' AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0)
   OR (p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL AND p.olympic_gold_medals <> '' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1)
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player
